items.why: Oil is sliding on Mideast hopes, and headlines say the drop is buoying sentiment as stocks rebound.
Amazon is rising with the broader rebound after Friday's selloff, as stocks bounce back across the board.
Alphabet is bouncing back after its worst day in history, part of the broader rebound after Friday's selloff.
Nvidia is rebounding with tech shares after Friday's selloff, even as headlines note October's dive tested the broader market's resilience.

market_note: Futures were higher, with Dow futures up about 1 percent and S&P futures up about 0.6 percent.
summary: Stocks are rebounding after Friday's selloff, helped by a sharp drop in oil prices on Mideast hopes. Tech names are leading the bounce, with Amazon and Alphabet among the biggest gainers.
